ownershipMask.hand: mask >= 128; retain source RGB and source alpha
ownershipMask.plaque: mask < 128; retain source RGB and source alpha
ownershipMask.unownedPixels: retain source RGB; alpha becomes zero

verification.pngRoundTrip: exact RGBA byte equality for both encoded layers
verification.assembledRawRGBA: exact equality with decoded reference at native registration
verification.scope: native 810 × 1440 pixels; browser scaling and animated occlusion require visual review

limitations: Two masked raster images, not 3D geometry, an anatomical rig, or an articulated grasp.
The hand retains a fixed supplied pinch pose and baked orange illumination.
Hidden plaque edges are absent. The isolated plaque has small contact cutouts; no pixels were invented.
At the right fingertip, glass and skin are optically mixed. The visible contact patch, including its short baked highlight, stays with the hand to avoid descending finger fragments.
No clean hidden hand surface, changing shadows, refraction, or new camera views can be recovered from these pixels.
Exclusive native-pixel masks can produce a small resampling seam at contact when scaled in a browser.
sourceRights: Client-supplied reference; no new third-party stock, generative content, or rights grant.
